Here are all the Items from all three versions. Personally I like the changes made in the Beta most. The data is now ordered in a way which lets you easily compare the different versions. There is one line for a stat if the data is equal throughout all versions, and otherwise there is one line for each version.

普通防具 | 普通武器 | 暗金防具 | 暗金武器 | 其他 | 任务物品

*PRDemo = 发售前版本
*Beta = 测试版本
*Retail = 正式发售版本
*Qlvl = Quality level, 物品的品质等级
属性中数字三行分别依次对应 PR/Beta/Retail
